title: Catalogue Entry 10,000
body:
# Catalogue Entry 10,000

*A note in Emile Nakamura-Osei's hand, written in the margin of the Atlas of Irregularities, beside entry number 10,000.*

We have now catalogued ten thousand things that should not exist but do.

Ten thousand anomalies. Ten thousand measurements that do not agree with themselves. Ten thousand places where the city does something it should not be able to do, and does it quietly, and does not explain.

I have spent twenty years measuring the immeasurable and I want to say this clearly, for whoever reads this after me:

The city is not a puzzle to be solved. It is a place to be inhabited. The anomalies are not errors. They are the city breathing.

We have mapped the breathing of a living thing and called it science. I am not sure it is science. I am sure it is necessary.

Entry 10,000. The Atlas continues.
